title: Pluto
html:
A map of the planet Pluto if it was converted into water and land. There is a bunch of islands at the north, so it will be great for boat shipping thing whatever.

Nations

The map features 16 named nations, including United States Colony, Russian Colony, European Space Agency, United Kingdom Colony, Chinese Colony and Japanese Colony.

Map data

  • Categories: Cosmic
  • Nations: 16
  • Public rotation frequency: 6
